text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her Debut race ahead, the members of 
the Symboli family place high hopes on 
Sirius Symboli to win the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The GⅠ race where Symboli Rudolf, on an 
undefeated 6-race winning streak, also 
claimed glory—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the only thing Sirius Symboli 
aimed for and set her sights on was the 
top of the world.
